fusion_summary: Merged WP805 already realizes the E1 core: cold restart versus checkpoint resume, exact source/target binding, public-only recovery checkpoints, matched comparison and explicit action/replay/repeated-work/terminal deltas.
No novelty or independent-replication credit is minted for this parallel convergence.

Residual future hardening 1: stronger efficiency credit should bind or deterministically derive action/replay/repeated-work counts from an exact evaluator execution trace rather than relying only on typed caller-supplied measurement arguments.

Residual future hardening 2: current contract proves cross-fixture/cross-holdout transfer; broader structural/OOD transfer claims require an explicit evaluator-side transfer-family/split identity and named transfer axis.
Oracle path regret is intentionally deferred until a stable admitted goal/optimality interface exists; adding it now could create false goal authority.
